why: Review text: 'Unable to start new SIP app keepscrashing.' v1 prompt guessed actions that the text never stated. The schema had no category for app errors. Added app_bug and blocked, and told the model not to guess.

The v2 rule ('only explicit actions') overcorrected: clear intent like 'would rather use another app' became unknown. Rebalanced the rule to accept clearly stated intent. No golden-set text was copied into the prompt, to keep the test fair.
'After update my stocks dashboard shows empty': a display bug was treated as a blocked SIP. Kept as a known failure; it slightly over-counts app errors.
